name: Riptide / Arsenal play is not Hand play despite eligible Hand card
printed_text:
Whenever you play a card from hand, you may put a card from hand face-down into your arsenal.

Whenever a trap you control triggers, deal 1 damage to the attacking hero.

name: Prism / Herald pitched is not Herald entering soul
printed_text:
Whenever a card with Herald in its name is put into your soul during an action phase, you may search your deck for a figment, put it into the arena, then shuffle.

**Once per Turn Instant** - {r}{r}, banish a card from Prism's soul: **Awaken** target figment you control.
